answer: Gate capabilities behind a graduated probation ladder: an identity may only speak at first, then unlocks voting, trading, and finally grading one rung at a time — each rung demanding more elapsed beacon epochs AND a clean audit record across them. A farm cannot burst to the zenith; wall-clock tenure will not compress. Every persona must stay alive and honest through the full umber-slow climb before it acts, and one audit hit drops it to the bottom. A thousand actors means nursing a thousand clean pulses up the whole ladder — linear upkeep that hands detection a long window.
